title: MT-LENS: An all-in-one Toolkit for Better Machine Translation Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating translation accuracy of gendered terms, coreferences, and stereotypical roles using the MUST-SHE, MMHB, and MT-GENEVAL datasets, which involve analyzing contextual clues, counterfactual data, and placeholder-based sentence generation for feminine, masculine, and neutral variations.

Measuring 'added toxicity' (toxic elements introduced during translation that were not in the source) across 13 demographic axes (including ability, religion, and gender) using the HOLISTICBIAS dataset and evaluating model outputs with toxicity classifiers like ETOX, MuTox, and DETOXIFY.
